decisions.reason: As a newly launched core garage-door operator with its own dedicated page, it fits the firm's main range and is likely to be supported rather than withdrawn so soon.
The solid wood sectional garage door is more niche and likely lower-volume, but it supports the firm's customization strategy and broad premium portfolio.
A garage door operator with remote control is close to customer expectations in the residential segment, so it is more likely to be retained as a sales variant than removed.
This glazed industrial sectional door faces some overlap risk within the industrial range, but it still matches the firm's focus on tailored building access solutions.
The glazed insulated industrial sectional door strengthens the firm's compliant thermal and industrial offering, which makes discontinuation unlikely after only one year.
Because this glazed industrial sectional door had its own dedicated page, it appears to be an actively promoted product that the firm is likely to continue.
